categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research reagent manufacturing sector, covering four main fields: high-end chemicals, life sciences, analytical chromatography, and materials science. The company also offers a small range of laboratory consumables under its 'Aladdin' and 'Core Silicon Valley' brands, mainly sold through its own e-commerce platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies including formulation, separation and purification processes, efficient synthesis, standard substance development, modification techniques, analytical methods, packaging, and filling processes. These technologies cover the entire lifecycle from R&D to final product formation, with some reaching international advanced levels. The company also emphasizes continuous R&D in catalyst preparation, molecular inhibitors, system analysis methods, and recombinant protein development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include scientists and frontline R&D engineers from universities, research institutes, and enterprises in biomedicine, new materials, new energy, energy conservation, environmental protection, aerospace, and other high-tech and emerging strategic industries. The products serve diverse research needs in genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, immunology, and more.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Singapore, the United States, Ireland, and Germany, serving both domestic and international markets. Its overseas subsidiaries focus on reagent R&D and sales targeting foreign customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aladdin operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, production, and sales of research reagents and laboratory consumables. It controls part of the supply chain by custom purchasing raw materials and performing subsequent processing internally to extend capacity and reduce costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-purity reagents, standard substances, and specialized reagents to meet growing domestic demand and reduce import dependence. R&D efforts focus on catalyst technology, molecular inhibitors, system analysis, recombinant proteins, and antibody development. The company also emphasizes e-commerce platform development to enhance customer experience and sales efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of research reagents and laboratory consumables via its proprietary e-commerce platform and third-party platforms like Tmall and JD.com. The company also receives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic market is dominated by foreign giants like Sigma-Aldrich and Thermo Fisher Scientific, but Shanghai Aladdin is among the leading domestic producers with a comprehensive product portfolio and recognized brand. It has been acknowledged as a top ten chemical reagent company in China for ten consecutive years and is actively breaking foreign monopolies through import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 533.56 million, a 32.44% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 98.76 million, up 15.07%. Total assets reached RMB 1.78 billion, growing 18.12%. The company has steadily expanded its scale, including the acquisition of a 51% stake in Shanghai Yuanye Biotech, contributing significantly to revenue and profit growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Aladdin emphasizes its independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and high-quality standards to provide reliable, high-purity reagents that meet diverse scientific research needs. Its strong brand reputation, advanced analytical and quality control methods, and efficient e-commerce sales model differentiate it from competitors. The company also offers tailored solutions and rapid service response, supporting domestic innovation and reducing reliance on imports.
